Interface ClientPayload

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Subinterfaces:
ConnectionClientPayload, GameClientPayload, LobbyClientPayload, PreLobbyClientPayload
All Known Implementing Classes:
AuthenticationPayload, ChooseCardPayload, CreateLobbyPayload, ExitLobbyPayload, ExtraDrawPayload, JoinLobbyPayload, ListLobbiesPayload, MoveTotemPayload, PongPayload, StartLobbyPayload
public interface ClientPayload extends Serializable
Marker interface for all data payloads sent from the client to the server.

Implementing classes represent arguments for various client actions, such as login credentials, lobby management commands, or in-game player decisions.
